diffs.diff: acceleration_g: datasheet reading gives 0.001 per count, the part's model has 1, 1, 1
diffs.evidence: LSM303DLHC datasheet (Doc ID 018771) Table 3: 'LA_So Linear acceleration sensitivity, FS bit set to 00: 1 mg/LSB' (2, 4, 12 mg/LSB at FS 01/10/11). The model's sim and driver use mg as the unit (sim unit 'mg', scale 1 after >>4 for 12-bit left-justified data), so 1 mg/count = 0.001 g/count. These are the same value in different units, which the publish gate does not convert.

diffs.diff: magnetic_field_xy_gauss: datasheet reading gives 0.000909 per count, the part's model has 1, 1, 1
diffs.evidence: LSM303DLHC datasheet Table 75 'Gain setting': GN=001, +/-1.3 gauss, 'Gain X, Y and Z [LSB/Gauss]' 1100, 'Gain Z' 980. 1/1100 gauss = 0.000909 gauss/count = 0.909 mgauss/count. The model's magnetometer sub-device (0x1E) uses mgauss with scale 0.90909 for X/Y (regs 0x03, 0x07) and 1.0204 (=1000/980) for Z (reg 0x05), and the driver divides by 1100 / 980. The gate's '1, 1, 1' lists only the accelerometer measures; the X/Y magnetometer scale matches the reading in mgauss.
